tailored_resume_bullets: Built a production-ready tours and travel management system using Angular, Node.js, Express, and MySQL during internship at Sunflower Trip, taken live for real customer bookings.
Implemented role-based access control (RBAC) with secure authentication, separating admin and end-user workflows across the platform.

Developed Zenvest, a full-stack trading platform using the MERN stack across three independently deployed services with JWT authentication and Joi-based request validation.
kit.cover_letter: Dear Hiring Manager, I am writing to apply for the Software Development Engineering Internship position at Nutrithy Wellness, as advertised. As an MCA student at PES University with a CGPA of 8.48 and hands-on full-stack development experience, I am eager to contribute to your engineering team. During my Full Stack Developer Internship at Sunflower Trip, I built a production-ready tours and travel management system using Angular, Node.js, Express, and MySQL, which went live for real customer bookings. I also implemented role-based access control and designed an admin dashboard for managing bookings and users. Additionally, through personal projects such as Zenvest and StaySphere, I have gained solid experience building scalable web applications with the MERN stack, implementing JWT and Passport.js authentication, and deploying services via Vercel, Render, and MongoDB Atlas. I am enthusiastic about the opportunity to bring my technical skills in backend and full-stack development to Nutrithy Wellness, especially given the potential PPO opportunity associated with this role. Thank you for your time and consideration, and I look forward to discussing how my background aligns with your needs.
